newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: DB says Export Gold outstrips Steinlager.
newsitem.headline: DB says Export Gold outstrips Steinlager.

text.p: DB Group Ltd chief executive Erik Kortals Altes on Wednesday said domestic sales of DB Export Gold had exceeded Lion Nathan's Steinlager over the last year.
"Our estimate is that we are bigger than Steinlager in volume, by hectolitres," Korthals Altes told a news conference.
"From our market research we see ongoing strong growth for Export Gold and what we get back from the market is that that is not happening with Steinlager," he said.
"The total volume that we are, on an annual basis, selling now of Export Gold has surpassed the total volume of Steinlager," he said.
Lion Nathan, with extensive operations in Australia and New Zealand, is DB's much larger competitor on the domestic market.
DB brewer earlier reported a NZ$17.2 million first half profit against $16.0 million a year earlier. Market expectations were for net profit of around $15-16 million.
